{{recipesummary|category=Recipes for dessert|servings=6|time=1 hour|difficulty=3}}
{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:North American cuisines|North America]] | [[Cookbook:Native American cuisine|Native American cuisine]] | [[Cookbook:Vegetarian cuisine|Vegetarian Cuisine]] | [[Cookbook:Dessert|Dessert]]

==Ingredients==

* 1 [[Cookbook:Quart|quart]] [[Cookbook:Milk|milk]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] cold [[Cookbook:Water|water]]
* 6 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoons]] [[Cookbook:Cornmeal|cornmeal]]
* ½ [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|teaspoon]] [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]
* 1 cup [[Cookbook:Molasses|molasses]]
* 1 teaspoon [[Cookbook:Baking Soda|baking soda]]
* 3 tablespoons [[Cookbook:Brown Sugar|brown sugar]]
* ½ teaspoon [[Cookbook:Nutmeg|nutmeg]]
* 1 tablespoon [[Cookbook:Ginger|ginger]]
* ½ teaspoon [[Cookbook:Cinnamon|cinnamon]]
* 4 [[Cookbook:Egg|egg yolks]], beaten
* 4 [[Cookbook:Egg White|egg whites]], whipped to stiff peaks

==Procedure==

# Set aside ½ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] of the milk. [[Cookbook:Boiling|Boil]] the remaining milk.
# Add cold water to cornmeal to wet it.
# Slowly pour the cornmeal mixture into the boiling milk. Add salt.
# Boil for 15 minutes, stirring constantly. If skin forms, remove it. Remove from heat, set aside.
# In a small bowl, mix molasses with baking soda, the ½ cup cold milk, and brown sugar.
# Add the spices and the beaten egg yolks to this mixture.
# Slowly pour the molasses mixture into the cornmeal mixture.
# [[Cookbook:Folding|Fold]] in the whipped egg whites.
# Grease or [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]] a [[Cookbook:Baking Dish|baking dish]], add the batter, and [[Cookbook:Bake|bake]] for 1 hour at [[Cookbook:Oven_temperatures|350°F]].
